fusions.name: Stampede Crack
fusions.desc: A thundering crack deals 28 damage to everything in a cone 6 tiles ahead, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Spurring Flick
fusions.desc: A spurring flick deals 7 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Give It Rein
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Heart
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
